silence_noise_db.source: mstack default chosen by the builder; not taken from a standard

silence_min_seconds.source: mstack default chosen by the builder; not taken from a standard

word_pad_seconds.source: mstack default: recognisers place word edges loosely, so each word is widened by this much before coverage is measured

bridge_gap_seconds.source: mstack default: two words closer than this count as one continuous stretch of speech

min_coverage.source: mstack default chosen by the builder; not taken from a standard

max_voiced_gap_seconds.source: mstack default: the longest stretch of voiced audio that may have no word

low_confidence.source: mstack default; recognisers scale confidence differently, so treat this as a starting point
